Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
For an adult Naturepedic mattress, a waterproof mattress protector is a useful pairing to help guard against spills and soiling, which aren’t covered by the mattress warranty. It isn’t required to keep the warranty valid. Make sure the mattress also rests on a firm, flat foundation; slats should be no more than 3 inches apart. Avoid placing the mattress directly on the floor.
